children: S.H.N. Financial Investments Ltd. disclosed a 5.716% stake in PRF Technologies Ltd. through a Schedule 13D. On Sep. 24, 2026, the firm also sent a letter calling for a special meeting of shareholders. The move signals an activist push to change the board and influence the company’s direction.

S.H.N. asked PRF Technologies to "convene a special general meeting" to vote on removing all current directors except Dr. Ellen S. Baron and Augustine Lawlor and to elect S.H.N.’s nominees. The firm says these changes aim to "enhance shareholder value and improve oversight" of the business.
S.H.N. plans to meet with the board, management, shareholders, and other parties, and it will seek shareholder support for its proposals.

S.H.N. Financial Investments Ltd. is an Israeli investment company incorporated in 2009. It invests its own working capital in public equities and may use margin loans in the ordinary course. Hadar Shamir and Nir Shamir each own 50% of S.H.N., share voting control, and Nir Shamir serves as CEO.
